headline: Birmingham in form, Cardiff's record keeps it close
summary: Cardiff sit 19th in the Championship with 11 points and host a Birmingham side that has scored 12 goals in its last five games. Cardiff's record in this fixture is the counterweight: they have won 3 of the last 5 meetings. On Saturday Cardiff drew 2-2 at Middlesbrough after leading, allowing 2.78 expected goals, and Birmingham Live reports that up to 10 players could miss this game. The market still makes Birmingham narrow favourites, 38.4% to 36.2%, and expects 3.0 goals, with the over at 49.3%.
read: Cardiff host Birmingham on Saturday with the market calling it close: Birmingham are 38.4% to Cardiff's 36.2%, their five-game unbeaten run just tipping the balance against home advantage. Cardiff led 2-0 at Middlesbrough last weekend before drawing with a man sent off, and goals are expected — the total is set at three.

facts.fact: Birmingham are the market's narrow favourites at 38.4% to Cardiff's 36.2%.
facts.meaning: Away favourites by a whisker — the market sees Cardiff's home ground as almost, but not quite, enough to level it.

facts.fact: Birmingham are unbeaten in five (WWWDW), scoring 12 and conceding 3, after a 3-0 home win over QPR on Saturday in which Liam Millar scored twice.
facts.meaning: The away side arrives as the form team in this fixture, at both ends of the pitch.

facts.fact: Birmingham sit 4th with 20 points from 11 games; Cardiff are 19th with 11.
facts.meaning: A nine-point gap after eleven games — and Cardiff have drawn five of theirs, a side that stays in matches rather than winning them.

facts.fact: Cardiff led 2-0 at Middlesbrough on Saturday and drew 2-2 after Osho was sent off.
facts.meaning: Two points dropped from a winning position at a promotion-chasing side, and Cardiff finished the game a man down.

facts.fact: Cardiff have won four of the last five meetings between the clubs, including 1-0 at Birmingham in April 2024.
facts.meaning: Recent history is the one thing running against Birmingham and helps keep this price close to level.

facts.fact: Birmingham Live reports that up to 10 players could miss this fixture.
facts.meaning: Both squads could be patched up, so the line-ups may look different from the weekend.

facts.fact: Birmingham Live reports that 10 of Birmingham's 22 goals in all competitions have come from their four wingers, including Demarai Gray, Carlos Vicente and Patrick Roberts.
facts.meaning: Birmingham's scoring threat is concentrated in wide areas rather than through a single centre-forward.

facts.fact: The market's main total is 3.0 goals, with Over priced at 49.3% — the fair line sits at 2.97.
facts.meaning: About three goals are expected, a high line for the Championship, with the over and under almost exactly level.
